notes: The native function returns five successive attribute-rating boosts for one attribute.
Each boost is at least +1 while room remains below the morphology cap.
Boost size depends on current rating and on the selected GNR player type's attribute weight.
The result is capped at the morphology maximum and unused slots return 0.
The five boosts are computed from the build passed into the native function; this file does not assume a global number of Cap Breakers owned by the user.
